```{r}
test <- open_matrix_dir(dir = "~/hpchome/final.counts.disk")
meta<- readRDS("~/hpchome/meta.rds")

asdf <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = test, meta = meta)

asdf@reductions$harmony.full <- readRDS("~/hpchome/harmony.full.rds")
asdf@reductions$full.umap <- readRDS("~/hpchome/full.umap.rds")
asdf@assays$sketch <- readRDS("~/hpchome/sketch.assay.rds")

Idents(asdf) <- asdf$orig.ident

DefaultAssay(asdf) <- "RNA"
asdf <- NormalizeData(asdf)

DimPlot(asdf, group.by = "orig.ident")+NoLegend()
DimPlot(asdf, group.by = "celltype", label = T)+NoLegend()
```


```{r}
`%!in%` <- Negate(`%in%`)
tcr_genes <- grep("^TR[ABGD][VDJ]", rownames(asdf), value = TRUE)
ig_genes  <- grep("^IG[HKL][VDJ]", rownames(asdf), value = TRUE)
ribo  <- grep("^RP[SL]", rownames(asdf), value = TRUE)
s.genes <- cc.genes$s.genes
g2m.genes <- cc.genes$g2m.genes
cell.cycle <- c(s.genes, g2m.genes)
hemoglobin <- grep("^HB[AB]", rownames(asdf), value = TRUE)
```


```{r}
meta <- asdf@meta.data

malig.all <- readRDS("~/hpchome/malig.all.final.rds")
meta$celltype.malig <- ifelse(meta$barcode.unique %in% malig.all, "malig", meta$celltype)

table(meta$celltype, meta$celltype.malig)

asdf@meta.data <- meta
```


```{r}
immune <- subset(asdf, celltype.malig %in% c("B_Cells", "Mast_Cells", "Myeloid", "T_Cells"))

DefaultAssay(immune) <- "RNA"
immune@assays$sketch <- NULL

table(immune$GEO.Cohort)
immune <- subset(immune, GEO.Cohort != "Iowa")

immune <- Split_Layers(immune, assay = "RNA", split.by = "GEO.Cohort")

immune <- FindVariableFeatures(immune, nfeatures = 2000)

immune <- SketchData(object = immune, ncells = 5000, method = "LeverageScore", sketched.assay = "sketch", over.write = T)
DefaultAssay(immune) <- "sketch"
immune <- JoinLayers(immune, assay = "sketch")

immune <- FindVariableFeatures(immune, nfeatures = 2000)
vf <- VariableFeatures(immune)
vf.ss <- setdiff(vf, c(tcr_genes, ig_genes, hemoglobin, cell.cycle, ribo))
VariableFeatures(immune) <- vf.ss

immune <- ScaleData(immune, vars.to.regress = "nFeature_RNA")
immune <- RunPCA(immune)
immune <- RunHarmony(immune, group.by.vars = "orig.ident", 
				reduction = "pca", assay.use = "sketch", reduction.save = "harmony", dims = 1:30, ncores = 30)
immune <- RunUMAP(immune, dims = 1:30, return.model = T, reduction = "harmony", umap.method = "umap-learn")

DimPlot(immune, group.by = "orig.ident", reduction = "umap")+NoLegend()
DimPlot(immune, group.by = "GEO.Cohort", reduction = "umap")+NoLegend()
DimPlot(immune, group.by = "celltype", reduction = "umap", label = T)+NoLegend()

immune <- FindNeighbors(immune, reduction = "umap", dims = 1:2)
immune <- FindClusters(immune, resolution = c(0.01,0.05,0.2))

DimPlot(immune, group.by = "orig.ident")+NoLegend()
DimPlot(immune, group.by = "GEO.Cohort")+NoLegend()
DimPlot(immune, group.by = "celltype", label = T)+NoLegend()
DimPlot(immune, reduction = "umap", group.by = "sketch_snn_res.0.01", label = T)+NoLegend()
DimPlot(immune, reduction = "umap", group.by = "sketch_snn_res.0.05", label = T)+NoLegend()
DimPlot(immune, reduction = "umap", group.by = "sketch_snn_res.0.2", label = T)+NoLegend()

```

```{r}
Idents(immune) <- immune$sketch_snn_res.0.01

markers.immune <- FindAllMarkers(immune, only.pos = T, min.pct = .1)
markers.immune$dif <- markers.immune$pct.1 - markers.immune$pct.2
markers.immune.ss <- markers.immune %>% group_by(cluster) %>% arrange(desc(dif)) %>% slice_head(n = 10)
```


```{r}
immune <- FindNeighbors(immune, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:30)
immune <- FindClusters(immune, resolution = c(0.1,0.3,0.5,0.8,1))

immune <- JoinLayers(immune, assay = "RNA")
immune <- ProjectIntegration(object = immune, sketched.assay = "sketch", assay = "RNA", reduction = "harmony")

immune <- ProjectData(object = immune, 
                    sketched.assay = "sketch", 
                    assay = "RNA", 
                    sketched.reduction = "harmony", 
                    full.reduction = "harmony.full",
                    recompute.neighbors = T,
                    dims = 1:30, 
                    refdata = list(sketch_snn_res.0.01 = "sketch_snn_res.0.01",
                                   sketch_snn_res.0.05 = "sketch_snn_res.0.05",
                                   sketch_snn_res.0.2 = "sketch_snn_res.0.2",
                                   sketch_snn_res.0.1 = "sketch_snn_res.0.1",
                                   sketch_snn_res.0.3 = "sketch_snn_res.0.3",
                                   sketch_snn_res.0.5 = "sketch_snn_res.0.5",
                                   sketch_snn_res.0.8 = "sketch_snn_res.0.8",
                                   sketch_snn_res.1 = "sketch_snn_res.1"), 
                    k.weight = 100, 
                    umap.model = "umap")


DimPlot(immune, reduction = "umap", group.by = "orig.ident", alpha = .1, pt.size = .1, raster = F)+NoLegend()
DimPlot(immune, reduction = "full.umap.1", group.by = "orig.ident", alpha = .1, pt.size = .1, raster = F)+NoLegend()

DimPlot(immune, reduction = "umap", group.by = "celltype", alpha = .1, pt.size = .1, raster = F)
DimPlot(immune, reduction = "full.umap.1", group.by = "celltype", alpha = .1, pt.size = .1, raster = F)

```

immune <- subset(immune, sketch_snn_res.0.01 != "10")

```{r}
DefaultAssay(immune) <- "sketch"
Idents(immune) <- immune$sketch_snn_res.0.3

markers.immune <- FindAllMarkers(immune, only.pos = T, min.pct = .1, max.cells.per.ident = 5000)
markers.immune$dif <- markers.immune$pct.1 - markers.immune$pct.2

markers.immune$cluster <- as.numeric(as.character(markers.immune$cluster))

markers.immune.ss <- markers.immune %>% group_by(cluster) %>% arrange(desc(dif)) %>% slice_head(n = 10)
```

```{r}
mat.immune <- immune@assays$RNA@layers$counts
rownames(mat.immune) <- rownames(immune)
colnames(mat.immune) <- colnames(immune)

write_matrix_dir(mat = mat.immune, dir = "~/hpchome/immune.mat.matrix.dir")

saveRDS(immune@assays$sketch, "~/hpchome/immune.sketch.assay.rds")
saveRDS(immune@reductions$harmony.full, "~/hpchome/immune.harmony.full.rds")
saveRDS(immune@reductions$full.umap.1, "~/hpchome/immune.full.umap.rds")

meta <- immune@meta.data
meta <- meta[,c(1:35,53)]
saveRDS(meta, "~/hpchome/immune.meta.rds")
```
